items.Sentence: Existing plant operations and processes include preliminary treatment with bar screening and grit removal,
primary treatment with primary sedimentation tanks,
secondary treatment with trickling filters and secondary sedimentation,
disinfection with sodium hypochlorite, and dechlorination with sodium bisulfite.

Planned Facility operations and processes are anticipated to include an equalization basin for storage of instantaneous peak flows; preliminary treatment, including screening and grit removal; secondary treatment by means of a membrane bioreactor (MBR), consisting of activated sludge biological process basins and submerged membrane filtration trains; and ultraviolet disinfection.
Effluent in excess of recycled water demands will not be chlorinated and will be pumped to a constructed wetland adjacent to the new treatment plant for polishing treatment.
Effluent recycled for use onsite or distributed to other users will be chlorinated.
